messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — webinar on 2026-04-12. Need X + LinkedIn teaser cadence and a short thread for developer audience. Two messaging variants: 'benchmark playbook' (data-first) vs 'developer story' (product-first). Want to A/B these across cohorts and test CTA: 'Register' vs 'Watch recording'. Need hero image, 30s clip, and one-line hook. Also need reply templates for high-intent comments and a routing plan to SDRs. Who can pick up assets? :calendar:

Tom (Social): I can take scheduling. Suggest M/W/F posts across cohorts to spread signal. Plan: Data variant -> cohort A, Story variant -> cohort B. Need final copy + assets by EOD Wed to hit schedule. Will use shortlinks xlnk.redwood.ai/XXXXX for tracking. :+1:

Priya (Content): On it — I'll draft three things: 1) X thread outline (4 tweets), 2) LinkedIn post (long-form + TL;DR), 3) reply templates (short, product-led, demo-request). Uploading initial drafts to Drive: /Marketing/Events/webinar-2026-04-12 by 2026-04-01 17:00 PT. Hero PNG and clip v1 will be in the same folder. :eyes:

Jorge (Growth): For inbound routing: recommend tag-based routing into HubSpot via Zapier. Pipeline name: webinar-social-2026. SDR triage rules: if comment or DM contains keywords (pricing|demo|enterprise|RFP) -> high-intent; if user profile indicates company email or >500 followers -> medium. I'll push the mapping and sample webhook later today. Will also add a UTM schema: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_apr2026&utm_content={variant}.

Cassie (Ops): Scheduling windows — avoid our planned infra maintenance: 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC. Proposed publish matrix (UTC):

```
Channel,Variant,Post Time (UTC)
X,Data,2026-04-08T15:00Z
LinkedIn,Story,2026-04-09T18:00Z
X,Story,2026-04-10T15:00Z
LinkedIn,Data,2026-04-11T18:00Z
```

Tom (Social): I'll queue these in Sprout/SocialStudio. Creating two muting rules for replies that look like spam. Engagement plan: two prompted follow-ups within 24h — first reply with extra stat + slide link, second reply with CTA to book. Also we should pin the top comment with the registration link for 48h. :pushpin:

Priya (Content): Draft reply templates (pick one per scenario):
- Short/neutral: "Thanks! Here's the registration link: xlnk.redwood.ai/reg-333 — we'll send the recording to everyone who signs up."
- Product question: "Great Q — we cover scaling and latency tradeoffs in the live demo. Join us: xlnk.redwood.ai/reg-333"
- Demo/price ask (SDR handoff): "Sounds like a good fit — can our SDR reach out? Please DM your email or sign up and we'll prioritize a follow-up."

Jorge (Growth): Regex for high-intent detection I'm proposing (example):
```
/(pricing|demo|enterprise|trial|po|rfp|purchase)/i
```
I'll push this into Zapier filter and HubSpot stage mapping by EOD.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Complete privacy review for clip usage and confirm music license by 2026-04-02. Also ensure Consent Checkbox on signup form is enabled.

Maya (Marketing): Awesome — next steps: Priya to upload drafts + assets by 2026-04-01 17:00 PT; Tom to queue posts and share the Sprout links; Jorge to produce Zap mapping and post-URL tags; Cassie to confirm no infra conflicts. Reconvene quick check 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks team! :zap:
